each year to this Department. It is not unreasonable to assume that failure to manage endangered species in a manner acceptable to the Secretary of Interior would result in withholding of highway funds.
There is no question that the federal authority to regulate interstate traffic and international traffic in such species should be strengthened. So much of the bill and statement supporting it we could endorse but not the removal from state jurisdiction of indigenous wildlife forms.
We appreciate having had the opportunity to comment on this statement.
Sincerely,
TAMANA ACALANA VAMES U. CROSS
Executive Director
